text:
ID   pTEST; SV 1; circular; DNA; STD; SYN; 60 BP.
AC   X99999;
DE   a test plasmid
KW   cloning vector.
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FT   CDS             join(complement(1..20),complement(31..50))
FT                   /gene="bla"
FT                   /label="AmpR"
FT                   /note="says ""hello"" here"
FT   promoter        5..15
FT                   /label="Ptest"
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     atgcatgcat gcatgcatgc atgcatgcat gcatgcatgc atgcatgcat gcatgcatgc        60
//

ID   pFULL; SV 2; circular; DNA; STD; SYN; 60 BP.
XX

XX

DE   becomes a GenBank definition line, and then some more words to be sure.
KW   cloning vector; expression.
OS   synthetic construct
OC   other sequences; artificial sequences.
CC   A comment line.
CC   And a second one.
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   source          1..60
FT                   /organism="synthetic construct"
FT                   /mol_type="other DNA"
FT   misc_feature    join(51..60,1..10)
FT                   /label="across the origin"
FT   CDS             complement(join(11..20,31..40))
FT                   /label="two exons"
FT                   /codon_start=1
FT                   /note="a note that is long enough to be wrapped over two lines of the
FT                   feature table, as a real one would be"
FT   gene            complement(41..50)
FT                   /gene="g"
FT                   /pseudo
XX
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     atgcatgcat gcatgcatgc atgcatgcat gcatgcatgc atgcatgcat gcatgcatgc        60
